content.short: Torum is a SocialFi Metaverse ecosystem dedicated to cryptocurrency users and projects.
content.description: Torum is a SocialFi Metaverse ecosystem designed for cryptocurrency users and projects. As a Web 3.0 community, Torum centers on a social media experience while offering a yield farming hub for DeFi participants, an NFT marketplace for crypto artists, and Avatar NFT features for Metaverse enthusiasts. The platform aims to be an open, safe, and interconnected entry point where cryptocurrency users can discuss and connect across diverse communities and projects.
